title: Pay the waste levy on waste received
what: Pay the State the waste levy on all levyable waste delivered to a levyable waste disposal site in the waste levy zone.

sources.title: Waste Reduction and Recycling Act 2011 (Qld)
sources.quote: The operator of a levyable waste disposal site is liable to pay the State a levy (the waste levy ) on all levyable waste that is delivered to the site if— (a) the levyable waste disposal site is in the waste levy zone;

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Waste Reduction and Recycling Act 2011 (Qld)

sources.title: Waste Reduction and Recycling Act 2011 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 26, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: or (b) if there is a waste levy instalment agreement in place between the chief executive and the operator of a levyable waste disposal site who owes the amount—the day provided for in the agreement;
